name: NIST AI 200-2 initial public draft — TEVV-Athlon Framework
known_limitations: NIST AI 200-2 is an initial public draft under comment through October 6, 2026. It is a framework for designing assessments, not evidence that a particular AI system is safe, effective, compliant, or validated.
source_owner: National Institute of Standards and Technology
automation_notes: Preserve draft status, August 7 announcement date, October 6 comment deadline, and system-specific validation boundary.
factual_nucleus: NIST announced the initial public draft of NIST AI 200-2 on August 7 with comments open through October 6. The draft describes a four-stage method for building customized AI-system assessments from organizational TEVV objectives.
